parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The listener port of the instance. Valid values: 0 to 65535.

parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.description:
The type of the protocol. Valid values:

*   **TCP**.
*   **UDP**.
*   **TCPSSL**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sae unbind-nlb --app-id 7171a6ca-d1cd-4928-8642-7d5cfe690000 --nlb-id nlb-7z7jjbzz44d82c9000 --protocol TCP --port 3306 --region cn-hangzhou
